preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of edges m must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of edges m must be at least n - 1 to ensure the graph is connected.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'Impossible' if m < n - 1 else True
postconditions.description: If m is less than n - 1, output 'Impossible'.

postconditions.expression: len(edges) == m and all(1 <= v <= n and 1 <= u <= n and v != u for v, u in edges)
postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly m edges, each connecting valid vertices without self-loops or multiple edges.

postconditions.expression: all(gcd(v, u) == 1 for v, u in edges)
postconditions.description: All edges in the output graph must connect vertices with a greatest common divisor of 1.
